title: Repossession and Collateral Recovery Weekend Recovery Charge
content:
Agency tariff term for recoveries completed on a weekend under Repossession and Collateral Recovery, as part of the agency recovery fee.

**Rule.** When the recovery date fell on a Sunday, a weekend recovery charge of 75.00 is added; when it fell on a Saturday, a weekend recovery charge of 50.00 is added; when it fell on a weekday, no weekend recovery charge is added.

The day of the week is the calendar weekday of the recovery date on the case (weekdays are reckoned on the ordinary calendar, on which 5 January 2026 is a Monday).

| Recovery date falls on | Weekend recovery charge |
|---|---|
| Sunday | 75.00 |
| Saturday | 50.00 |
| Monday to Friday | none |

## Calendar illustration (hypothetical recovery dates)

| Recovery date | Weekday | Charge |
|---|---|---|
| Friday 9 January 2026 | Friday | none |
| Saturday 10 January 2026 | Saturday | 50.00 |
| Sunday 11 January 2026 | Sunday | 75.00 |
| Monday 12 January 2026 | Monday | none |

A federal holiday that falls on a weekday is still a weekday for this charge.
